overview: From 2026-10-12 to 2026-10-13, ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io had 2 new PRs (0 merged), 0 new issues, and 19 active contributors.

topPRs.title: Add Liquid Mercury (MERC) on Base
topPRs.author: kelm2021
topPRs.body:
Adds Liquid Mercury (MERC) on Base and its current Ethereum origin address, using the documented `nobridge: true` option. The Base token is Wormhole-wrapped and is not a canonical OP Standard Bridge token; this submission does not request inclusion in the Optimism Bridge app.

Only `data/MERC/data.json` and `data/MERC/logo.svg` are added. Generated token-list output is unchanged. The legacy Ethereum address `0xa203eb78fee91c8459c6d4ef3a899d8724ee5b35` is excluded.

Public references:
- Official website and both current contract links: https://merc.liquidmercury.com/
- Token social: https://x.com/MERC_token
- Company social: https://x.com/LiqMercury
- Ethereum: https://etherscan.io/address/0x6EE2f71049DDE9a93B7c0EE1091b72aCf9b46810#code
- Base: https://basescan.org/address/0x8923947EAfaf4aD68F1f0C9eb5463eC876D79058#code
- CoinGecko: https://www.coingecko.com/en/coins/liquid-mercury
- CoinMarketCap: https://coinmarketcap.com/currencies/liquid-mercury/

Metadata evidence:
- Public RPC calls on both chains return `name() = "Liquid Mercury"`, `symbol() = "MERC"`, and `decimals() = 18`, with deployed code present. No metadata overrides or expected-mismatch files are used.
- An independent block-pinned read on 2026-10-12 verified Ethereum chain 1 at block 26179406 and Base chain 8453 at block 52527511; a second public RPC read confirmed the same metadata.
- The actual CoinGecko JSON at https://tokens.coingecko.com/uniswap/all.json includes the current Ethereum address (chainId 1, MERC, Liquid Mercury, 18 decimals). This is distinct from merely having a CoinGecko project page. The JSON timestamp read was `2026-10-11T17:05:49.641-05:00`.
- No issues or PRs matched either current address, MERC, or Liquid Mercury in the upstream duplicate check on 2026-10-12.

Logo:
- Copied unchanged from https://merc.liquidmercury.com/merc-logo.svg.
- SHA-256 of both the downloaded file and staged Git blob: `e32ded1d85b0b5203f2d68eec67db72b61674216753670a12e4b0630aa431aa1`.
- Existing 1024 by 1024 SVG dimensions and viewBox are preserved; 1024 CSS pixels corresponds to 768 points, exceeding the documented minimum. No artwork or dimensions were edited.

Validation:
- Locked dependencies installed with pnpm 8.6.0; validator run with Node 22.14.0.
- The unmodified documented command `npx tsx ./bin/cli.ts validate --datadir ./data --tokens MERC` reaches token validation but crashes in list generation on Windows because `glob` interprets `path.join()` backslashes as escape characters and finds no logo.
- The same command was rerun with a temporary external runtime shim that only changes glob pattern backslashes to forward slashes. No repository validator code, validation checks, warnings, or submitted files were changed. Result: exit code 0, zero validation errors and zero token-validation warnings. Node emitted its experimental-loader warning.

Verification limitation: the upstream Etherscan V1 endpoint currently returns `status: "0"`, `message: "NOTOK"`, with the deprecated-V1-endpoint message. Its existing validator does not surface that response as a verification warning. Therefore, a clean local result must not be read as independent Etherscan source-verification confirmation; maintainer review of the linked explorers remains necessary. Direct explorer page retrieval in this environment was blocked. Fee-on-transfer and rebasing behavior have not been independently audited, and no claim about those behaviors is made.

This is a public metadata contribution ready for maintainer review. List inclusion remains discretionary; this submission makes no endorsement or wallet-verification claim.

topPRs.title: Add HEXPUNK on Base
topPRs.author: adolfochzs
topPRs.body:
**Description**

Adding HEXPUNK token to the Superchain token list on Base.

- **Name**: HEXPUNK
- **Symbol**: HEXPUNK
- **Decimals**: 18
- **Chain**: Base (`base`)
- **Address**: `0xb20000000000000000000024A9Cd928Ff6277db8`
- **Website**: https://www.hexpunk.xyz
- **Type**: Native Base B20 precompile asset (`nonstandard: true`, `nobridge: true`)

**Tests**

Validated `data.json` format against the repo schema with `nonstandard: true` and `nobridge: true`. Logo included as a 512x512 PNG at `data/HEXPUNK/logo.png`.

**Additional context**

HEXPUNK is an on-chain cultural experiment deployed on Base as a native B20 asset with a strictly capped, immutable supply of 3,000,000 tokens.
Liquidity is deployed on Aerodrome V2 (HEXPUNK/USDC: `0x703b56c521d76ee9a409d61c751df3c6e75ace64`) and 100% locked until year 2106 in Aerodrome's V2Locker (`0xd27ce5cae39bc70650454f58e5bc9ed9cb794355`).
